reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o:number[]=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function parityBuckets(s:string):string|null{let m=7,a:number[]=[];let k=0,lo=0,hi=0;if(m===3){const q=s.split(';'),kp=nums(q[0]),ap=nums(q[1]);if(q.length!==2||kp===null||ap===null||kp.length!==1||kp[0]<0)return null;a=ap;k=kp[0]%a.length}else if(m===5){const q=s.split(';'),lp=nums(q[0]),hp=nums(q[1]),ap=nums(q[2]);if(q.length!==3||lp===null||hp===null||ap===null||lp.length!==1||hp.length!==1||lp[0]>hp[0])return null;a=ap;lo=lp[0];hi=hp[0]}else{const ap=nums(s);if(ap===null)return null;a=ap}if(m===0)return a.slice(1).map((x,i)=>Math.max(-1000,Math.min(1000,x-a[i]))).join(',');if(m===1){let z=-Infinity;return a.map(x=>z=Math.max(z,x)).join(',')}if(m===2){let o:number[]=[] as number[],z=Infinity;for(let i=a.length-1;i>=0;i--)o[i]=z=Math.min(z,a[i]);return o.join(',')}if(m===3)return(k?a.slice(-k).concat(a.slice(0,-k)):a).join(',');if(m===4)return a.filter((x,i)=>a.indexOf(x)===i).map(x=>x+':'+a.filter(y=>y===x).length).join(',');if(m===5)return a.map(x=>Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,x))).join(',');if(m===6)return a.slice(1).map((x,i)=>x*a[i]).join(',');if(m===7)return a.filter(x=>x%2===0).concat(a.filter(x=>x%2!==0)).join(',');if(m===8){let n=0;return a.map((x,i)=>n+=i%2?-x:x).join(',')}let bv=a[0],bl=1,cv=a[0],cl=1;for(const x of a.slice(1)){if(x===cv)cl++;else{cv=x;cl=1}if(cl>bl){bv=cv;bl=cl}}return bv+':'+bl}
